schema.description:
Your homunculus will seek out and attack monsters whenever its HP percent (as percent of maximum HP; a number from 0-100) is greater than this value. When it lacks HP, it will only fight monsters if it is attacked.

Set this value to 100 if you do not want the homunculus to attack unless it, the owner, or a friend is attacked.
schema.name: AggroHP

schema.description: Your homunculus will seek out and attack monsters whenever its SP percent (as percent of maximum SP; a number from 0-100) is greater than this value. When it lacks SP, it will only fight monsters if it is attacked.
schema.name: AggroSP

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your homunculus to keep its distance from monsters while attacking.
schema.name: KiteMonsters

schema.description: If you want your homunculus to not fight or do anything other than watch (and kite, if set to do so), set this value to true. This is generally useless for a homunculus.
schema.name: SuperPassive

schema.description: If you want your homunculus to automatically use offensive skills when attacking, set this to true.
schema.name: UseAttackSkill

schema.description:
If you plan to have both a mercenary and homunculus out at the same time, set this value to true.

The default is true.
schema.name: AssumeHomun

schema.description: If you want your homunculus to stand still and only use ranged skills or attacks, set this value to true.
schema.name: DoNotChase

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your homunculus to bypass ASPD by dancing while attacking. Only recommended if your homun has nooffensive skills
schema.name: UseDanceAttack

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your homunculus to exit the client if it sees a monster listed in H_Avoid.lua
schema.name: UseAvoid

schema.description: When set to tank monsters for others to kill, gather this many monsters before waiting for them to be killed.
schema.name: TankMonsterLimit

schema.description: When set to a positive value, when owners HP as a percent is less than this, always rescue, regardless of TACT_RESCUEWhen set to a negative value, when owners HP as a percent is more than this, disable rescue entirely
schema.name: RescueOwnerLowHP

schema.description: When the owner is is not moving, attack monsters within this distance of the owner.
schema.name: StationaryAggroDist

schema.description: When the owner is is moving, attack monsters within this distance of the owner. See also StationaryAggroDist. This should probably be relatively low so that the homun does not get left behind after chasing something while the owner is moving
schema.name: MobileAggroDist

schema.description: If enabled, the homunculus will switch targets if a better targetis closer.
schema.name: OpportunisticTargeting

schema.description: If enabled, targets with the ATTACK_LAST tactic will only beattacked if the homun is at full SP
schema.name: AttackLastFullSP

schema.description: If UseDanceAttack is enabled, the homun will only 'dance' if it has at least this much SP as a percent
schema.name: DanceMinSP

schema.description: This is the longest time, in milliseconds, that the homunculus will spend trying to attack a target which it has already attacked - this is to prevent homun from getting hung up on posbugged or inaccessible monsters. As of 1.54, this timer is reset if we see the monster flinching while nothing else is targeting it - that should mean that we're successfully attacking it, and should keep going
schema.name: AttackTimeLimit

schema.description: If you experience lag that appears only with homunculus out on some maps, try setting this to 1. This will reduce responsiveness on maps that do not lag.In severe cases, this can be set to 2, or even higher. This will greatly slow the homunculus' reaction time, and should be used only if truly necessary
schema.name: LagReduction

schema.description: If set to true, homun will not attack monsters that are currently moving
schema.name: DoNotAttackMoving

schema.description: If enabled, and owner has merc out, and merc has LiveMobID enabled as well, the mercenary will be able to identify monsters on screen as long as the homun is alive. See the documentation for more details and caveats. This may cause performance problems on some systems.
schema.name: LiveMobID

schema.description: To control SP use, you may not want your homunculus to use skills unless there would be enough SP left to recast some sort of buff. Set this value to this minimum SP value to control this this.
schema.name: AttackSkillReserveSP

schema.description: If the homunculus has an anto-mob skill, the skill will be automatically used if the number of monsters in close proximity to the homunculus or owner is equal to or greater than this value.
schema.name: AutoMobCount

schema.description: If you want your homunculus to use skills while attacking and while chasing if their skill has a longer range than their normal attack, set this to Chasing. If you want it to use skills only while in melee range, set this to Attacking. If you want it to only use skills and not attack normally, set this to SkillOnly.
schema.name: UseSkillOnly

schema.description: Extra AI delay in milliseconds; 0 removes this margin, not server cooldowns. If you are having problems with the homunculus "double casting" skills, increase this value. Otherwise, leave it be.
schema.name: AutoSkillDelay

schema.description: Offensive cast interruptions before temporarily skipping that skill. 0 disables the protection. Success resets the counter. Buffs and combos are excluded; unconfirmed failures count only with CastInterruptUnconfirmed enabled.
schema.name: CastInterruptLimit

schema.description: Also count failed offensive casts with no visible casting motion or confirmed completion, when the target is alive and in range and SP is sufficient. May include server refusals, not just interruptions. Uses CastInterruptLimit/Pause. Disabled by default; H_Extra.lua overrides take precedence.
schema.name: CastInterruptUnconfirmed

schema.description: Milliseconds to skip an offensive skill after CastInterruptLimit confirmed interruptions. Other usable skills or normal attacks remain available. Positive integer; default 5000 ms. Does not change server cooldowns.
schema.name: CastInterruptPause

schema.description: Enable this to not use non-AoE skill attacks unless doing so would leave enough SP to cast the homun's AoE attack.
schema.name: AoEReserveSP

schema.description: Enable this to ignore skill level tactics when using  AoE attacks.
schema.name: AoEFixedLevel

schema.description: Select whether to automatically use anti-mob skills and whetherto base that decision on the number of aggressive monsters in theAoE, or the number of ALL monsters, aggressive or not
schema.name: AutoMobMode

schema.description: Keep fighting a monster you ordered the homunculus to attack until it dies or you give another order, even if you walk away. Turn off to let it give up and return when the target leaves the move bounds or AttackTimeLimit passes. An H_Extra.lua override takes precedence.
schema.name: CommandedFightStay

schema.description: Enable the inherited Vanilmirth attack skill Caprice for Vanilmirth-based homunculi.
schema.name: UseVanilCaprice

schema.description: If enabled, we will try to hit as many targets as possible withan AoE skill, even if that means we don't hit the target we werecurrently attacking
schema.name: AoEMaximizeTargets

schema.description: Keep this many cells away from you (0 = follow normally). Useful to clear instances with an ungeared owner. Limited by the move bounds; the homunculus still fights monsters that come near.
schema.name: StayAwayDistance

schema.description: With StayAwayDistance: park at one spot and return to it after fights, instead of following your every step.
schema.name: StayAwayHold

schema.description: Always attack MVPs, even when the tactics only react to them or BossAggro avoids them. Requires UseMobInfo.
schema.name: AttackMVPs

schema.description: 0: off. 1: other monsters are only fought back (react). 2: other monsters are ignored entirely. Requires UseMobInfo.
schema.name: AttackOnlyMVPs

schema.description: Your homunculus will stay this many cells behind you when following you.
schema.name: FollowStayBack

schema.description:
If set to rest, the homunculus will move this many cells east of you when you sit.

Setting this to a negative number will cause the homunculus to move west instead.
schema.name: RestXOff

schema.description:
If set to rest, the homunculus will move this many cells north of you when you sit.

Setting this to a negative number will cause the homunculus to move south instead.
schema.name: RestYOff

schema.description: Set this to false if when you sit down, you want your homunculus to become passive, and, when it becomes idle, will move close to you.
schema.name: DoNotUseRest

schema.description:
Upon spawning, the homunculus will wait for this many miliseconds before taking any actions. This prevents it from wasting its immunity time and also prevents it from KSing after teleporting or changing maps.

Setting this value to 1000 (1 second) is a good idea.
schema.name: SpawnDelay

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your homunculus to stay put when told to go somewhere.
schema.name: MoveSticky

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your homunculus to fight normally if MoveSticky is set to true.
schema.name: MoveStickyFight

schema.description: When at full hp with nothing better to do, set this option to the pattern that it should walk in. See documentation formore information before using Route walk
schema.name: UseIdleWalk

schema.description: Only use IdleWalk when SP is above this, as a %
schema.name: IdleWalkSP

schema.description: Enable this to use castling for route walk. See documentation.
schema.name: UseCastleRoute

schema.description: Enable this to use relative routes. See documentation
schema.name: RelativeRoute

schema.description: When walking while idle, keep this distance from owner.
schema.name: IdleWalkDistance

schema.description: Enable this to make the homun delay moving to a new target when it is below a specified SP level, AND is expecting an SP-regen tick in the near future. This is an extreme measure to deal with SP problems resulting from the homun never staying still long enough to regen any SP (homuns do not regen sp while moving). WARNING: This will make your homun pause after each kill, and this may be undesirable. Use this only if you understand this option. See documentation for details.
schema.name: ChaseSPPause

schema.description: When ChaseSPPause is enabled, and SP is below this threshold, the homun may pause if near an SP tick.If set to a negative number, this is treated as a percentage. Otherwise, it is simply the number of SP.
schema.name: ChaseSPPauseSP
schema.note: DefaultValue attr says -20 (field initializer is 0; SetDefaults()/Reset in the C# GUI uses the attr value -20)

schema.description: if ChaseSPPause is enabled, and SP is below the specified threshold, the homun will pause if it is expecting an SP tick within this length of time.This is specified in milliseconds, ie, 2000 = 2 seconds. The homun SP tick is every 8 seconds
schema.name: ChaseSPPauseTime

schema.description: This is the farthest from the owner that the homun will be allowed to get before dropping all targets and moving back to the owner. This value is used while the owner is NOT moving (see also MobileMoveBounds) To control aggro range of homun, use the AggroDist options, not MoveBounds. To set distance from owner that homun should return to after killing use FollowStayBack, not MoveBounds.
schema.name: StationaryMoveBounds

schema.description: This is the farthest from the owner that the homun will be allowed to get before dropping all targets and moving back to the owner. This value is used while the owner IS moving (see also StationaryMoveBounds) To control aggro range of homun, use the AggroDist options, not MoveBounds. It matches StationaryMoveBounds by default; lower it if the homunculus gets left behind while you walk.
schema.name: MobileMoveBounds

schema.description: Set this to when you want your homunculus to use offensive buff skills: Flitting, Mental Charge and Blood Lust
schema.name: UseOffensiveBuff

schema.description: Set this to when you want your homunculus to use defensive buff skills like Amist Bulwark, Accellerated Flight and Urgent Escape
schema.name: UseDefensiveBuff

schema.description: Set this value to the level of Lif Urgent Escape.
schema.name: LifEscapeLevel

schema.description: Set this value to the level of Filir Flitting.
schema.name: FilirFlitLevel

schema.description: Set this value to the level of Amistr Bulwark.
schema.name: AmiBulwarkLevel

schema.description: When autocasting the Filir skill Accellerated Flight use thislevel. Note that only at level 1 can it be kept up full time.
schema.name: FilirAccelLevel

schema.description: Set this value to the minimum HP (as a percent of maximum HP) required for your homun to use healing skills.
schema.name: HealOwnerHP

schema.description: If your homun is a Vani, and UseAutoHeal is enabled then useChaotic Blessings to try to heal homun when it's below thismuch hp
schema.name: HealSelfHP

schema.description: Use healing skill (Healing Hands or Chaotic Blessing) to healowner or self. See HealSelfHP, HealOwnerHP to set at what HPto start healing
schema.name: UseAutoHeal

schema.description: If this is enabled, we will use Silent Breeze to heal the owner. Obviously don't use this on servers without the Silent Breeze nerf, or if not immune to silence
schema.name: HealOwnerBreeze

schema.description: Do not use use a defensive buff (Painkiller) on the owner unlessthey have at least this many monsters attacking them, and thethe owner's HP as a percentage is below DefensiveBuffOwnerHP
schema.name: DefensiveBuffOwnerMobbed

schema.description: Enable this to use castling to defend the owner when he ismobbed.
schema.name: UseCastleDefend

schema.description: If UseCastleDefend is enabled, then it will be used when the owner has this many monsters on him and the homun has less
schema.name: CastleDefendThreshold

schema.description: Amistrs sometimes run themselves out of SP to keep up other buffs in order to keep Amistr Bulwark up. If this is option is enabled, Bulwark will only be used if the Amistr has enough SP to cast all other buffs it is configured to.
schema.name: UseSmartBulwark

schema.description: If (and only if) DefensiveBuffOwnerMobbed is enabled (ie, set to a non-zero value), defensive buffs (painkiller and Kyrie)will be used only when there are at least the specified numberof monsters on the owner, and the owner's HP (as a percentage)is lower than DefensiveBuffOwnerHP
schema.name: DefensiveBuffOwnerHP
schema.note: Shown in the grid but never loaded, saved, or reset by HomConf (no H_Config.DefensiveBuffOwnerHP mapping); the C# GUI does not persist it

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your mercenary to kite away frommonsters before being attacked by them
schema.name: KiteParanoid

schema.description: Move this many cells when kiting.
schema.name: KiteStep

schema.description: Move this many cells when kiting from a monster that.has not yet attacked the mercenary.
schema.name: KiteParanoidStep

schema.description: Kite when a monster is within this many cells.
schema.name: KiteThreshold

schema.description: Kite when a monster that has not yet attacked is within this many cells.
schema.name: KiteParanoidThreshold

schema.description: When kiting do not exceed this distance from owner
schema.name: KiteBounds

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your homunculus to kite monsters.even if it has no ranged attack. This may result in odd behavior
schema.name: ForceKite

schema.description: If non-zero and kiting is enabled, only kite below this percent HP
schema.name: FleeHP

schema.description: React to damage taken: when the homunculus loses DamageDangerDrop percent of its max HP within 3 seconds while below DamageDangerHP percent HP, it kites away (even without KiteMonsters) and Bayeri casts Stein Wand.
schema.name: UseDamageDanger

schema.description: Percent of max HP lost within 3 seconds that counts as danger (UseDamageDanger).
schema.name: DamageDangerDrop

schema.description: Danger only counts while HP is below this percent (UseDamageDanger).
schema.name: DamageDangerHP
StandbyFriending
schema.note: C# uses an empty Description() attribute

schema.description: Set this to true if you want the homunculus to emulate MirAI friending.
schema.name: MirAIFriending

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your homunculus to defend you even while in standby.
schema.name: DefendStandby

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your homunculus to return to standby mode after attacking, using skills, etc.
schema.name: StickyStandby

schema.description: If you want your homunculus to go berzerk while being attacked, set this to a value greater than 0. Otherwise, set it to 0 to disable berzerk mode while being mobbed.
schema.name: UseBerserkMobbed

schema.description: Set to true to have your homunculus go berzerk when told to use a skill on a target.
schema.name: UseBerserkSkill

schema.description: Set this to true to have your homunculus go berzerk when told to attack a target.
schema.name: UseBerserkAttack

schema.description: Set this to true to ignore skill use limits while in berzerk mode.
schema.name: Berserk_SkillAlways

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your homunculus to use dance attack while in berzerk mode.
schema.name: Berserk_Dance

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your homunculus to ignore AttackSkillReserveSP when in berserk mode.
schema.name: Berserk_IgnoreMinSP

schema.description: Set this to true if you want to use your homunculus in PVP enabled maps.
schema.name: PVPmode

schema.description: Official: Gravity servers. Private: rAthena/Hercules servers. This changes actor identification and skill compatibility, not the selected homunculus filter.
schema.name: ServerType
schema.note: Written as the bare Lua identifier SERVER_OFFICIAL (Official) or SERVER_PRIVATE (Private); reading also accepts 0/1. Additional option: loaded from Defaults.lua then H_Config.lua, appended if missing

schema.description: Automatically switch to private-server actor identification when rAthena/Hercules monster IDs are detected.
schema.name: AutoDetectServerType

schema.description: Remaining variable cast time after reductions: 0 = no variable cast time, 1 = full variable cast time.
schema.name: CastTimeRatio
schema.note: Not clamped: setter throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException if NaN or outside 0-1. Written with invariant culture (e.g. 0.5)

schema.description: Use Amistr Castling to protect the owner in the selected AI states.
schema.name: UseProvokeOwner

schema.description: Allow the inherited Amistr Blood Lust buff.
schema.name: AllowBloodlust

schema.description: Allow inherited Filir SBR44, which consumes intimacy.
schema.name: AllowSBR44

schema.description: Use the monster database (MobInfo.lua: element, race, size, boss/MVP and plant of every monster) to pick skills and to treat bosses and plants. Set to false for the old behavior.
schema.name: UseMobInfo

schema.description:
Attack skills are left out against a target whose element would cut their damage below this percent (0-200). Immune targets (0% or less) are always skipped.

Example: fire skills do 90% to Water 1 monsters and 0% to Fire 2 monsters.
schema.name: SkillElementMinRate

schema.description: Use skills on plants and mushrooms too. They take 1 damage from everything, so by default skills are saved for other monsters and plants don't count for area skills.
schema.name: PlantSkills

schema.description:
Bosses the homunculus never starts a fight with, whatever the tactics say; it still defends you and itself when they attack.

Tactics: the tactics decide. React to MVPs: MVPs. React to bosses: MVPs and mini-bosses.
schema.name: BossAggro

schema.description: Choose the next target by more than distance. Among targets with the same tactics priority: monsters attacking you or a friend first, plants last, targets your skills can hurt (element), the center of the biggest cluster when an area skill is available, then the closest.
schema.name: TargetPriority

schema.description: Kite by the monster's real attack range (monster database). Ranged monsters make the homunculus kite earlier and with a longer step, a monster that never chases only matters inside its range, and none is kited when its range reaches KiteBounds (there would be no way out). Melee monsters keep KiteThreshold. Needs UseMobInfo.
schema.name: KiteByRange

schema.description: Whether to believe the client's answer to the skill-range probe that tells which skills are learned. Automatic: distrust it on the official server and trust it on private servers (rAthena). Distrust / Trust force either. Distrusted, a skill is tried even when the probe says it is not learned, and never lowered after a refusal. An H_Extra.lua override takes precedence.
schema.name: TrustSkillProbe

schema.description: Ask the client which skill levels are learned and adapt (Probe). Never probe requests exactly the level set in the options, capped to the skill's maximum, and never lowers it when the server refuses; use it on a server whose probe answers cannot be trusted.
schema.name: SkillLevelProbing

schema.note: C# Save() assigns M_Config.UseProvokeOwner twice (same value); harmless.

schema.description: Use Magnificat on mercenary profiles that have the skill, including Wicked Nymph and Official/Casual Pope. This works like the other mercenary buffs.
schema.name: UseAutoMag

schema.description: Do not use use a defensive buff (Kyrie) on the owner unlessthey have at least this many monsters attacking them, and thethe owner's HP as a percentage is below DefensiveBuffOwnerHP
schema.name: DefensiveBuffOwnerMobbed

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your level 2 archer mercenaryto use sight.
schema.name: UseAutoSight

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your mercenary to use Sacrifice on you. Note that you must be within 10 levels of your mercenary and that the skill is buggy.
schema.name: UseSacrificeOwner

schema.description: Use the buff skill Blessing on owner in this situation
schema.name: UseBlessingOwner

schema.description: Use the buff skill Blessing on the mercenary itself in this situation
schema.name: UseBlessingSelf

schema.description: Use the buff skill Kyrie Eleison on owner in this situation Use DefensiveBuffOwnerMobbed and DefensiveBuffOwnerHP to onlyuse this skill when the owner is under attack
schema.name: UseKyrieOwner

schema.description: Use the buff skill Kyrie Eleison on the mercenary in this situation
schema.name: UseKyrieSelf

schema.description: Use the buff skill Increase Agi on owner in this situation
schema.name: UseIncAgiOwner

schema.description: Use the buff skill Increase Agi on mercenary in this situation
schema.name: UseIncAgiSelf

schema.description: If (and only if) DefensiveBuffOwnerMobbed is enabled (ie, set to a non-zero value), defensive buffs (painkiller and Kyrie)will be used only when there are at least the specified numberof monsters on the owner, and the owner's HP (as a percentage)is lower than DefensiveBuffOwnerHP
schema.name: DefensiveBuffOwnerHP

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your mercenary to kite away frommonsters before being attacked by them
schema.name: KiteParanoid

schema.description: Move this many cells when kiting.
schema.name: KiteStep

schema.description: Move this many cells when kiting from a monster that.has not yet attacked the mercenary.
schema.name: KiteParanoidStep

schema.description: Kite when a monster is within this many cells.
schema.name: KiteThreshold

schema.description: Kite when a monster that has not yet attacked is within this many cells.
schema.name: KiteParanoidThreshold

schema.description: When kiting do not exceed this distance from owner
schema.name: KiteBounds

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your mercenary to kite monsters.even if it has no ranged attack. This may result in odd behavior
schema.name: ForceKite

schema.description: If non-zero and kiting is enabled, only kite below this percent HP
schema.name: FleeHP

schema.description: Set this to true if you want the mercenary to emulate MirAI friending.
schema.name: MirAIFriending

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your mercenary to defend you even while in standby.
schema.name: DefendStandby

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your mercenary to return to standby mode after attacking, using skills, etc.
schema.name: StickyStandby

schema.description: If you want your mercenary to go berserk while being attacked, set this to a value greater than 0. Otherwise, set it to 0 to disable berserk mode while being mobbed.
schema.name: UseBerserkMobbed

schema.description: Set to true to have your mercenary go berserk when told to use a skill on a target.
schema.name: UseBerserkSkill

schema.description: Set this to true to have your mercenary go berserk when told to attack a target.
schema.name: UseBerserkAttack

schema.description: Set this to true to ignore skill use limits while in berserk mode.
schema.name: Berserk_SkillAlways

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your mercenary to use dance attack while in berserk mode.
schema.name: Berserk_Dance

schema.description: Set this to true if you want your mercenary to use ignore AttackSkillReserveSP when in berserk mode.
schema.name: Berserk_IgnoreMinSP

schema.description: Set this to true if you want to use your mercenary in PVP enabled maps.
schema.name: PVPmode
